# Frozen baseline fixtures, taken from accepted main

These bytes were produced by the code at
`0a9dbaaf8173ea039ad2e6b0aafb34539a642d50` — the merge of PR #240, on `main` —
by running that revision's own `stage_request` under its own test fixture. They
are not reconstructed here, and they are not regenerated by anything in this
tree.

That is the whole point. Comparing two constructors from the current
implementation against each other shows only that the current implementation
agrees with itself. It cannot show that a record written before a change is
still read as what it meant. Only bytes that predate the change can show that.

## What is frozen

`worker_request_v2_main/` — one complete staged worker request as main wrote it:

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Request schema | `carbon.c03.worker-request.v2` |
| Accelerator block | `{profile_id, grant_digest, role}` — three fields, no device |
| Profile named | `carbon_jax_cuda13_rtx3060_laptop_development_v1` |
| That profile's digest | `sha256:8408adc8c7a3650bbbfb8d188be7dadae2df1e3c851f5b72a0e086bdcc012e79` |

The profile it names pinned one host's device into the workload itself, which is
why the request carries no device field: the device came from the profile.

## Why the archive is base64

`train.npz` is stored as `train.npz.base64`. The repository forbids committing a
numpy payload anywhere under `tests/`, and that invariant is not worth bending
for a fixture. The encoded bytes are the originals - `sha256:5fd001963ab0c59c…`,
28 bytes - and the test decodes them and checks that digest against the one the
frozen request itself names, so a mistake in the encoding fails loudly instead
of quietly substituting a different archive.

## Rules

**Do not regenerate these files, and do not update the expected values in the
tests that read them.** A test that fails against this fixture is reporting that
a record accepted on main no longer decodes the way it was accepted. The repair
belongs in the decoder, not in the expectation.

If a genuinely new serialized shape is introduced, give it a new version and add
its own fixture beside this one. Leave this one alone.
